entities.name: Aran
entities.description: A young man from Bant, known for faith and innate goodness, who became Elspeth Tirel's loyal squire.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Planeswalker who took Aran into her service and revived him.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: Shard of Alara where Aran lived.

entities.name: Valeron
entities.description: Place Aran was not originally native to.

entities.name: Rhox monastery
entities.description: Monastery near Fort Dawnray where a monk had killed his brethren.

events.summary: Elspeth takes Aran into her service after the death of his parents.
events.quote: Aran became Elspeth Tirel 's loyal squire when she took him into her service after the death of his parents.

events.summary: Aran and Elspeth find the Rhox monastery's monks killed by one of their own and meet Grixis zombies.
events.quote: After entering the monastery they were soon confronted for the first time by zombies from Grixis .

events.summary: Aran falls in the war against Grixis and Elspeth revives him.
events.quote: Elspeth revived him, despite the many laws against such an act.

events.summary: Aran suggests Elspeth should lead the war, but she knows she must leave the plane.
events.quote: He then suggested that Elspeth should lead this war.

relations.quote: Aran became Elspeth Tirel 's loyal squire
